0.content: Lisa calls Jean a gifted and dedicated leader whose hard work makes even Lisa want to help. Jean says that when Lisa is around, she always has peace of mind, and she looks to Lisa for potions to keep her awake. Lisa was at Jean's side when the Traveler first came to headquarters (1.0) and went to the Temple of the Lion because "Jean trusts me". She helped organise the Knights' party for Jean during her day off. She sometimes greets people sleepily with "Good morning, Jean" before realising who it is.

1.content: Razor was raised by wolves in Wolvendom and brought into contact with the Knights by Varka. Lisa taught him how to use his Electro elemental energy and never expected him to master it so fast. He calls her "Teacher" and sums her up as "Lisa lightning makes the sky black. She is strong. She is scary." Her voice-over has her coaxing him to combat practice ("good boy!") only for him to bolt.

2.content: Lisa studied for two years in the Spantamad Darshan under the sage Cyrus, who calls her his best student in two hundred years. She graduated, then went straight home. Officially the reason was unknown. Privately: she saw raving-mad scholars in the forests and powerful sages wasting away on advisory councils, and asked how much one must sacrifice for the deepest knowledge. Unwilling to pay, she left and has stopped short of taking things too seriously ever since.

3.content: Lisa took a liking to the Traveler at their first meeting and has called them "cutie" ever since. She offers to be their teacher, master or friend, and plays at making them her "star pupil" with a forehead kiss in one voice line. She is curious why the Traveler can use the elements without a Vision. In her Serenitea Pot dialogue she says they are special to her and that she does not count the effort when it is for them. This affectionate teasing is her character; canon gives them no romance.

4.comment: Lisa: The Library and Overdue Books
4.content: The library at the Knights of Favonius Headquarters is, Lisa says, the largest in northern Teyvat, and she has read every book in it. She signs books in and out at the counter like a languid cat. Every library copy carries an elemental marker so it can be traced. In her Story Quest (Tempus Fugit Chapter, 1.0) the Traveler wanted a travel guide; finding it overdue, Lisa went door to door collecting books, and learned from Donna that one had been stolen. They followed its elemental trail to a ruin. There a Cryo Abyss Mage named Emery claimed the book held "the secret" and refused to give it back; Lisa electrocuted him on the spot. The book was an ordinary copy of The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies.

5.content: Klee says Lisa is the best because she sneaks her treats at the workshop. Lisa once refused to let Klee use the workshop for experiments, and Klee sulked for a day before happily going off to play. During a limited-time 1.6 event, Lisa helped Klee and the Traveler read the Dodo-King's summons. She found hidden elemental script on the letter, had the Traveler copy it with Elemental Sight, and recognised the Golden Apple Archipelago from sailors' legends in her books.
